inline helper defined in 1 episode(s), 1 turn(s), called 5 times
The player oscillates because it decides one action per turn and re-tests. This skill batches up to 6 movement actions in one turn, driving the cluster toward the target directly.
The player wastes 44-114 turns with no action and re-tests known actions. This step forces it to use the batch-move skill once dynamics are known.
